title: 關角隧道~New Guanjiao Tunnel
focus: 高原施工、斷層變形與長距離物流~Plateau construction, fault deformation and long-distance logistics
summary: 中國政府公開記錄新關角隧道32.645公里及2014年4月雙線正洞貫通，這個事件不是通車日期。本課從高原長距離施工出發，研究弱帶支護、地下水、通風密度修正、多工作面物流與控制網。所有空氣密度及機具數字明列為假想條件，不代替高海拔現地測量。~Government records identify New Guanjiao as 32.645 km and both main bores breaking through in April 2014, distinct from opening to traffic. This course studies plateau construction through weak-zone support, water, ventilation-density correction, multi-heading logistics and survey. Air density and equipment values are hypothetical and do not replace high-altitude measurements.

units.anchor: 路線里程與端點~Alignment chainage and endpoints
units.title: 服務邊界與路線代價~Service boundaries and alignment cost
units.mechanism: 新關角鐵路取代山區繞行的教學比較需固定站間端點，分開隧道時間與全線坡度及接線效益。隧道選線同時改變洞口、覆土與縱坡，短路線不保證低地質風險。比較方案必須使用相同起訖點，並分開主孔、引道及服務坑的工程數量；交通時間只是需求的一個指標，不能代替施工可達性或長期維修評估。~A railway realignment comparison fixes station endpoints and separates tunnel time from grade and approach benefits. Alignment changes portals, cover and gradient together, so a shorter tunnel need not have lower geological risk. Compare options between identical endpoints and distinguish running bores, approaches and service galleries. Travel time measures one service benefit but cannot replace assessment of construction access, maintenance closures or exposure to uncertain ground.
units.model: 原創教學假設：長度=20 km；速度=60 km/h。t=60L/v=20 min。僅把長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為22 min。邊界：假想交通旅程，未含加減速、排隊及實際時刻表；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: length=20 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=20 min. Increasing only length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 22 min. Boundary: Hypothetical transport journey excluding acceleration, queues and the real timetable. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 用相同停站及速度假設比較路線，不混用直線距離。把縱斷面、地形與地質剖面疊合，以端點坐標獨立反算距離，再將主孔與支坑數量分開核對。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Compare routes with equal stopping and speed assumptions, not straight-line distances. Overlay the longitudinal profile, terrain and geology; independently derive distances from endpoint coordinates and reconcile running-bore and gallery quantities separately. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 只比較隧道長度無法代表取代展線後的完整服務差。混用全線與單孔長度會同時扭曲工程數量、行程及逃生距離，造成方案比較失去共同基準。~Tunnel length alone does not represent the full effect of replacing a winding route. Mixing whole-route and single-bore lengths distorts quantities, journey time and escape distance, destroying the common basis of an option comparison.
units.misconception: 最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。~The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
units.practice: 本案「路線里程與端點」的交付需回答：用相同停站及速度假設比較路線，不混用直線距離。在方案表中凍結起訖點、計量範圍及地質假設，任何改線都要同步更新高程、數量與服務情境，不能只替換總長。~For New Guanjiao Tunnel, the alignment chainage and endpoints handover must address the following evidence: Compare routes with equal stopping and speed assumptions, not straight-line distances. Freeze endpoints, measurement scope and ground assumptions in the option register; realignment requires coordinated updates to elevations, quantities and service scenarios rather than replacing one length.

units.title: 破碎帶連通與預報更新~Fault connectivity and forecast updating
units.mechanism: 高原弱帶施工的教材用節理填充及破碎程度更新預報，避免把高強度岩塊視為整體穩定。斷層帶可以含很硬的岩塊，但整體變形與湧水常由填充節理和連通裂隙控制。單一岩芯強度不能代表整個掌子面；超前鑽孔、出水變化與揭露地質須回饋同一里程模型，預報則應保留不同情境及其證據權重。~Update weak-zone forecasts from infill and fragmentation instead of equating strong blocks with stable ground. A fault zone may contain strong intact blocks while filled joints and connected fractures govern its bulk deformation and inflow. One core strength does not represent the entire face. Probe records, water response and exposed geology must update a common chainage model, preserving competing interpretations and their evidential weight rather than treating a forecast as certainty.
units.model: 原創教學假設：滲透係數=1e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.1 無因次；通水面積=400 m²。Q=k i A=0.00084 m³/s。僅把滲透係數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.000924 m³/s。邊界：均質飽和達西流，不代表裂隙集中流；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=1e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.1 dimensionless; flow area=400 m². Q=k i A=0.00084 m³/s. Increasing only conductivity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.000924 m³/s. Boundary: Homogeneous saturated Darcy flow, not concentrated fracture flow. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 將探孔、掌子面和收斂沿同一里程對照。將岩心回收、裂隙方位與出水曲線按里程對齊，用未參與建模的孔段作交叉檢驗，檢查是否只擬合已知資料。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Compare probes, face maps and convergence along common chainage. Align recovery, fracture orientation and inflow by chainage; test the interpretation against a withheld borehole interval to detect fitting only the known observations. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 完整試件很強仍可能在軟弱填充帶發生大變形。只用完整岩石強度會漏掉軟弱填充物，可能在看似堅硬的地層中出現收斂加快、支護過載或水量突增。~Strong intact specimens can coexist with large movement in weak infilled bands. Intact strength alone misses weak infill, allowing accelerating convergence, support overload or sudden inflow in ground that superficially appears strong.
units.misconception: 岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。~Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow.
units.practice: 本案「破碎帶連通性」的交付需回答：將探孔、掌子面和收斂沿同一里程對照。每次地質模型更新保留舊版與新增證據，差異由地質及支護設計者共同判讀，施工條件改變需重新確認核准範圍。~For New Guanjiao Tunnel, the fault-zone connectivity handover must address the following evidence: Compare probes, face maps and convergence along common chainage. Retain previous interpretations and new evidence at every update; geology and support designers jointly interpret differences and reconfirm approved bounds when ground conditions change.

units.anchor: 支護安裝時點~Support activation time
units.title: 支護啟動與變形容量~Support activation and deformation capacity
units.mechanism: 新關角弱帶情境重點是支護變形容量和封閉時序，教材比較硬支護與可容納位移的反應。支護荷載由開挖釋放量和支護啟動時間共同決定，越早安裝不一定讓構件受力越小。地盤反力與支護曲線必須連同掌子面距離及封閉順序理解；擠壓性地層還需保留變形容量，不能只追求高剛度與高材料強度。~The weak-zone scenario focuses on deformation capacity and closure time, comparing stiff support with movement-compatible response. Support load depends on stress release and activation time, so earlier installation does not necessarily reduce member forces. Interpret ground-reaction and support curves together with distance from the face and closure sequence. Squeezing ground also needs deformation capacity; high stiffness and material strength alone do not guarantee a compatible support response.
units.model: 原創教學假設：局部剛度=50 kN/mm；位移=7 mm。F=ku=350 kN。僅把位移增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為385 kN。邊界：線性局部彈簧，不含屈服或時間效應；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=50 kN/mm; movement=7 mm. F=ku=350 kN. Increasing only movement by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 385 kN. Boundary: Local linear spring without yielding or time effects. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 同步量測支護荷重與收斂速率，標註安裝距離。同步記錄收斂、支護荷重與安裝里程，比較同一地質分區內的速率及荷載，不將不同開挖齡期讀值直接混合。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Measure support force and convergence rate with installation distance recorded. Synchronise convergence, support loads and installation chainage; compare rates and loads within one ground domain without mixing readings at different excavation ages. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 只增剛度可能提高受力卻沒有提供必要變形行程。過晚封閉會讓不可回復變形增加，過硬且行程不足的支護也可能脆裂，兩者都可能表現為裂縫而需不同處理。~Added stiffness can raise force without providing the necessary movement capacity. Late closure increases irreversible movement, while excessively stiff support with little travel can fail brittly; both produce cracks but require different diagnoses.
units.misconception: 支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。~Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
units.practice: 本案「支護安裝時點」的交付需回答：同步量測支護荷重與收斂速率，標註安裝距離。把安裝時間和量測資料一起交付支護設計者，任何級別變更都需地質及位移證據，不能憑單一瞬間讀值自行改支護。~For New Guanjiao Tunnel, the support activation time handover must address the following evidence: Measure support force and convergence rate with installation distance recorded. Submit installation times with measurements to the support designer; class changes need both ground and movement evidence, not an isolated instantaneous reading.

units.anchor: 量測區間平均速率~Interval-average movement rate
units.title: 位移速率與基準漂移~Movement rate and datum drift
units.mechanism: 長施工區段需比較不同開挖齡期的收斂，教材將平均速率、短時加速和測點重置分開。收斂讀值包含岩體反應、支護作用及量測系統本身的變化，兩次讀值差只能得到區間平均速率。基準點移動、溫度與觀測頻率都會改變判讀；判定加速或趨穩時，需要多個獨立位置和同一施工時間軸，不以單點曲線取代整個斷面。~Across long work zones, distinguish age-dependent convergence, short acceleration and reset monuments. Convergence combines ground response, support action and measurement-system changes. Two readings yield only an interval-average rate. Datum motion, temperature and sampling frequency affect interpretation, so acceleration or stabilisation needs independent locations and a common construction timeline rather than one point standing for the entire section or an unobserved short-duration peak.
units.model: 原創教學假設：位移增量=14 mm；時間間隔=3.3 day。v=Δu/Δt=4.24242 mm/day。僅把位移增量增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為4.66667 mm/day。邊界：兩讀值平均速率，不表示未觀測的短時峰值；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: movement increment=14 mm; interval=3.3 day. v=Δu/Δt=4.24242 mm/day. Increasing only movement increment by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 4.66667 mm/day. Boundary: Mean between two readings, not unobserved short-term peaks. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 保留原始讀值及測點更換日期，核對短時高頻資料。同時檢查基準點穩定、儀器重複性及多點位移，將開挖步距和溫度加進趨勢圖，對異常先做獨立重測。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Retain raw readings and replacement dates and check short-interval data. Check datum stability, repeatability and multiple movement points together, adding excavation steps and temperature to trends and independently repeating anomalies. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 重設零點會讓持續變形看似歸零，不能當穩定證據。量測點被換位置而延用舊零點可製造假加速，反過來重設零點不保留舊值又會掩蓋持續累積變形。~Resetting zero makes continuing movement appear absent and is not stability evidence. Relocation with an old zero creates false acceleration, while resetting without preserving history hides cumulative deformation.
units.misconception: 兩次讀值的平均速率就是期間內任何時刻的最大速率。~The average between two readings is the maximum rate at every time in the interval.
units.practice: 本案「量測區間平均速率」的交付需回答：保留原始讀值及測點更換日期，核對短時高頻資料。基準或儀器改動保留前後重疊讀值，警戒條件由責任工程師按量測能力核准，異常處置前先確認資料可比性。~For New Guanjiao Tunnel, the interval-average movement rate handover must address the following evidence: Retain raw readings and replacement dates and check short-interval data. Retain overlapping readings across datum or instrument changes; the responsible engineer approves triggers against measurement capability and verifies comparability before intervention.

units.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓~Piezometric head and lining pressure
units.mechanism: 高原地層補注受季節影響，教材分析凍融或降雨時序與深部裂隙水頭的不同反應。水壓取決於連通含水層的測壓水頭，不必等於地表或海面至洞頂的幾何深度。排水降低水壓卻可能增加有效應力與沉陷；停泵或排水堵塞後水頭又會回升，因此防水、排水及環境保水是互相制約的設計選擇。~Seasonal recharge affects plateau ground; distinguish surface thaw or rainfall timing from deep-fracture head response. Water pressure follows piezometric head in the connected aquifer, not automatically the geometric depth below ground or sea level. Drainage reduces pressure but can increase effective stress and settlement. Head may recover after a pump outage or blockage, coupling waterproofing, drainage capacity and preservation of surrounding groundwater in the permanent design.
units.model: 原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=114 m。p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1118.34 kPa。僅把水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為1230.17 kPa。邊界：靜水表壓，不是土體總壓或原位量測；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=114 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1118.34 kPa. Increasing only head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 1230.17 kPa. Boundary: Hydrostatic gauge pressure, not total earth pressure or an in-situ measurement. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 比較季節水頭、出流與探孔壓力回復。使用分層測壓管及流量計，配合降雨或潮位序列分辨補注與設備影響，將讀值統一換算至同一高程基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Compare seasonal head and inflow with probe-pressure recovery. Use nested piezometers and flowmeters with rainfall or tide histories to distinguish recharge from equipment effects, converting observations to a common elevation datum. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 表層暫時乾燥不能排除深部持續高水頭。將暫時降水後的低水頭當成永久狀態，會漏掉停泵後外壓回升；過度排水也可能引起周邊地層壓密。~Temporary surface dryness does not exclude persistent deep head. Treating temporarily lowered head as permanent misses pressure recovery after outage; excessive drainage can also consolidate surrounding ground.
units.misconception: 目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。~No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
units.practice: 本案「測壓水頭」的交付需回答：比較季節水頭、出流與探孔壓力回復。設計檢核應分列正常排水、堵塞與停電水位，將環境受體的容許變化和監測責任一起交付，不把抽水量當唯一指標。~For New Guanjiao Tunnel, the piezometric head handover must address the following evidence: Compare seasonal head and inflow with probe-pressure recovery. Separate normal drainage, blocked-drain and power-outage heads and hand over receptor limits and monitoring responsibility together rather than using pump flow as the sole indicator.

units.anchor: 風道摩擦壓損~Duct friction loss
units.title: 通風網路與壓力損失~Ventilation network and pressure loss
units.mechanism: 高海拔空氣密度改變壓損和機械性能，教材所有密度都為假設，不能沿用海平面額定風量作結論。風機提供壓差，實際風量由風道摩阻、局部損失、外風與其他風機共同決定。支路開關會重新分配整個網路，不能把額定風量直接加總；正常污染稀釋與火災控煙也有不同目標，需要分別建立受控邊界和故障情境。~Altitude changes air density, pressure loss and machine performance; hypothetical density cannot justify copying sea-level ratings into conclusions. Fans supply pressure, but actual flow follows friction, local losses, external wind and interactions with other fans. Switching a branch redistributes the network rather than simply adding rated flows. Routine dilution and fire smoke control have different objectives, so each needs explicit boundaries, operating states and failure cases rather than one universal flow target.
units.model: 原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=1300 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.5 m/s。Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=59.7188 Pa。僅把平均風速增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為72.2597 Pa。邊界：定密度直管摩阻，局部損失及外風另計；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=1300 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.5 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=59.7188 Pa. Increasing only mean velocity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 72.2597 Pa. Boundary: Constant-density straight-duct friction; local loss and external wind are separate. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 量測現地溫壓及風速，再比較風機實際工況。沿線同步量測靜壓與風速，記錄風門及其他風機狀態，再把實測工作點和風機曲線、網路壓損比較。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Measure local temperature, pressure and velocity before comparing fan operating points. Measure pressure and velocity synchronously, record dampers and other fans, and compare the measured duty point with fan curves and network resistance. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 體積流量相同不代表質量流量和污染稀釋條件完全相同。只看風機轉速會漏掉風門誤位或短路漏風，可能在總耗電增加時，真正需要的區段反而風量不足。~Equal volumetric flow does not ensure equal mass flow or dilution conditions. Fan speed alone misses a misplaced damper or leakage shortcut; total power may rise while the critical section receives less air.
units.misconception: 風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。~Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
units.practice: 本案「風道摩擦壓損」的交付需回答：量測現地溫壓及風速，再比較風機實際工況。驗收採明確風門和車流邊界，維修改線後重新核對網路工作點，火災模式由防災責任工程師簽認而非沿用正常模式。~For New Guanjiao Tunnel, the duct friction loss handover must address the following evidence: Measure local temperature, pressure and velocity before comparing fan operating points. Commission with specified damper and traffic boundaries, recheck duty points after rerouting, and have the fire-safety engineer approve emergency modes independently.

units.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸~Shared access and transport bottlenecks
units.mechanism: 長斜井及多工作面的物料循環受高原設備利用率影響，教材把運輸與工作面切削分開排程。多工作面只有在供電、通風、出渣與材料供應同步充足時才增加總產量。共用豎井或軌道形成串聯瓶頸，排隊和維修窗口會降低名目容量；緩衝區太大又可能侵占通行與救援空間，因此不能單純把各面產能相加。~Long accesses and multiple headings couple transport with equipment availability; schedule haulage separately from cutting. Multiple headings increase output only when power, air, muck transport and materials support them together. Shared shafts or railways become serial bottlenecks, while queues and maintenance reduce nominal capacity. Large buffers may obstruct personnel and rescue access, so face capacities cannot simply be added without a network-level transport and storage check.
units.model: 原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=40 t；往返週期=36 min。C=N payload 60/T=266.667 t/h。僅把往返週期增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為242.424 t/h。邊界：無排隊理想循環，並非共享路段實際產能；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=40 t; cycle=36 min. C=N payload 60/T=266.667 t/h. Increasing only cycle by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 242.424 t/h. Boundary: Ideal cycle without queues, not actual shared-route production. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 按載重、坡度及等待重建完整往返循環。以裝載質量、往返時間及排隊時間重建物流曲線，再核對緩衝占用、共用通道優先權與維修時段。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Reconstruct round trips using payload, gradient and waiting time. Reconstruct flow from payload, round-trip and queue times, then check buffer occupancy, shared-route priorities and maintenance periods. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 只用平地車速估循環會低估斜井和卸料占時。把理想往返時間當全天常數會忽略交會等待與卸料堵塞，導致工作面停工或把材料堆入必要通道。~Using level-road speed understates access-gradient and unloading time. Treating an ideal cycle as constant all day misses passing delays and unloading blockages, stopping headings or pushing material into essential access space.
units.misconception: 增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。~Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
units.practice: 本案「出渣運輸節拍」的交付需回答：按載重、坡度及等待重建完整往返循環。每日排程同時標示人員、材料和維修的占用時段，任何物流改線先檢查通風與應變通道，不能只看運量提升。~For New Guanjiao Tunnel, the muck-transport cycle handover must address the following evidence: Reconstruct round trips using payload, gradient and waiting time. Schedules show personnel, materials and maintenance occupancy together; rerouting first checks ventilation and emergency access rather than only throughput gains.

units.title: 控制網與貫通誤差~Control network and breakthrough error
units.mechanism: 多斜井傳遞控制到深部主孔時，教材研究每條入口網絡誤差是否獨立，不能任意平方和。長隧道的微小方向誤差會沿距離累積，地下控制網又缺少直接衛星定位，必須把地表基準可靠傳到洞內。閉合差很小不代表無系統誤差；尺度、折光、儀器定向與高程基準可能共同偏移，誤差相關性也使平方和估算失真。~Multiple access networks transfer control underground; test independence before combining errors by root-sum-square. Small orientation errors accumulate over long drives, while underground networks lack direct satellite positioning and depend on transferring surface control. A small closure does not exclude systematic bias: scale, refraction, orientation and vertical datum may shift together. Correlated errors also invalidate a naive root-sum-square combination of supposedly independent observations.
units.model: 原創教學假設：控制長度=5400 m；方向偏角=2.7 arcsec。e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0706858 m。僅把方向偏角增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0777544 m。邊界：小角度方向偏差，未加入控制網相關性及折光；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: control length=5400 m; orientation error=2.7 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0706858 m. Increasing only orientation error by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0777544 m. Boundary: Small-angle orientation error without network correlation or refraction. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 比較各入口原始基準和共同控制點的相關性。由獨立測量組複核地表到洞內的轉換，保留原始角距及溫度資料，用不同控制線比較方向與高程偏差。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Compare reference origins and correlations among shared control points. Independently check surface-to-tunnel transformations, retain raw angles, distances and temperatures, and compare orientation and elevation through separate control routes. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 共享基準誤差會在多面網絡一致存在而未被互比發現。共用錯誤基準可能讓兩組測量同時看似一致，直到貫通或軌道銜接才發現系統偏差，修正成本遠高於早期複核。~Shared datum error persists across headings and escapes mutual comparison. A shared wrong datum can make separate surveys appear consistent until breakthrough or track connection exposes bias that is costly to correct.
units.misconception: 兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。~Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
units.practice: 本案「方向角誤差」的交付需回答：比較各入口原始基準和共同控制點的相關性。貫通前凍結座標、尺度與高程版本，獨立組直接使用原始觀測重算；不得只傳遞整理好的坐標而遺失校正資訊。~For New Guanjiao Tunnel, the orientation error handover must address the following evidence: Compare reference origins and correlations among shared control points. Freeze coordinate, scale and height revisions before breakthrough; independent reviewers recompute raw observations rather than receiving only adjusted coordinates without corrections.

units.title: 基線縱坡與牽引需求~Base-alignment grade and traction demand
units.mechanism: 高原列車坡度功率教材只計重力分量，另列空氣密度、車輛性能和營運規則需求。基線鐵路用較小縱坡降低重載列車的重力阻力，但仍有滾動、空氣阻力及加速需求。土建線形和供電容量必須使用同一列車與速度情境，短距陡坡也不能被平均坡度掩蓋；制動方向的能量處理則是另一個需要獨立檢核的工況。~The plateau traction exercise calculates only gravity demand while retaining separate density, vehicle-performance and operating-rule needs. A base alignment reduces heavy-train gravity resistance through gentler gradients, but rolling resistance, aerodynamic drag and acceleration remain. Civil geometry and power capacity must use consistent train and speed cases. Short steep sections cannot be hidden in an average gradient, while braking energy in the opposite direction requires its own operating and electrical assessment.
units.model: 原創教學假設：列車質量=1.6e+06 kg；縱坡=0.0066 無因次；速度=20 m/s。P=mgiv/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=2071.87 kW。僅把縱坡增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為2279.06 kW。邊界：僅坡度阻力，不含滾動、氣動、加速及效率；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: train mass=1.6e+06 kg; grade=0.0066 dimensionless; speed=20 m/s. P=mgiv/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=2071.87 kW. Increasing only grade by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 2279.06 kW. Boundary: Grade resistance only, excluding rolling, aerodynamic, acceleration and efficiency losses. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 核對質量、坡度單位和速度，將其他阻力另表。以里程高程表逐段計算坡度，對照列車性能曲線和供電模型，另檢核低速牽引及下坡制動，不只比較平均功率。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Check mass, grade units and speed and list other resistance separately. Calculate local grades from chainage and elevation, compare with train-performance and power models, and separately check low-speed traction and downhill braking. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 低空氣密度不會減少列車重力坡度阻力。平均坡度低卻存在短陡坡時，峰值功率可能超過預估，速度下降又會增加區段占用時間，牽連營運容量。~Lower air density does not reduce gravitational grade resistance. A short steep grade can exceed power estimates despite a low average, reducing speed and extending block occupation with capacity consequences.
units.misconception: 基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。~A small base-tunnel gradient eliminates the need for traction and braking analysis.
units.practice: 本案「坡度阻力功率」的交付需回答：核對質量、坡度單位和速度，將其他阻力另表。軌頂高程交付前，由土建、軌道、供電和營運共同確認同版線形及列車包絡，變更坡度時同步更新性能與容量計算。~For New Guanjiao Tunnel, the grade-resistance power handover must address the following evidence: Check mass, grade units and speed and list other resistance separately. Civil, track, power and operations teams approve one alignment and train envelope before handover; grade changes update both performance and capacity calculations.

units.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接~Asset identity and traceable handover
units.mechanism: 長距離多工區資料交付需把斜井里程轉成主孔統一索引，教材研究同名測點的識別問題。地下設備的竣工資料必須讓維護人員找到正確位置、材料批次和控制版本。只有上傳圖面而沒有變更歷程，無法分辨元件替換與真正劣化；告警、儀器、線路及工單使用一致識別碼，才可能把量測趨勢連回實際受力或水力系統。~Long multi-lot handover converts access chainages into main-bore indexing and resolves similarly named monitoring points. Handover must let maintainers find the correct location, material batch and control revision. Drawings without change history cannot distinguish replacement from deterioration. Consistent identifiers across alarms, instruments, circuits and work orders are essential for linking trends to the physical structural or hydraulic system instead of treating each record as an isolated file.
units.model: 原創教學假設：設備總數=120 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。coverage=100(N−missing)/N=86.6667 %。僅把缺紀錄數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為85.3333 %。邊界：資料完整度，不等於安全或可靠度；擾動為連續敏感度，實際個數為整數；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: asset count=120 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=86.6667 %. Increasing only missing records by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 85.3333 %. Boundary: Record completeness, not safety or reliability; perturbation is continuous sensitivity while actual counts are integers. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 抽查測點可追到主孔位置、安裝時間和校正紀錄。抽取一條告警，從控制畫面追到設備、線路、圖面和工單，核對位置、版本及校正日期並記錄無法閉合的欄位。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Trace monitoring points to main-bore location, installation time and calibration. Trace a sampled alarm from screen to equipment, circuit, drawing and work order, checking location, revision and calibration dates and recording broken links. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 斜井里程未轉換會把異常收斂定位到錯誤地質區。設備改名卻未更新控制畫面會引導人員隔離錯誤回路，材料批次缺漏則使同批缺陷無法追蹤到其他位置。~Unconverted access chainage places abnormal convergence in the wrong ground domain. Renaming an asset without updating the screen can isolate the wrong circuit; missing material batches prevent tracing related defects at other locations.
units.misconception: 全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。~Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
units.practice: 本案「資產資料完整度」的交付需回答：抽查測點可追到主孔位置、安裝時間和校正紀錄。交接以可完成的定位、查找與復原任務驗證，由維護責任人確認現場可用性；完整度只是資料指標，不代表結構安全或設備可靠。~For New Guanjiao Tunnel, the asset-record completeness handover must address the following evidence: Trace monitoring points to main-bore location, installation time and calibration. Validate handover through achievable location, retrieval and recovery tasks witnessed by maintainers; completeness measures records, not structural safety or equipment reliability.

example: 原創綜合審查：先計算「破碎帶連通與預報更新」，再獨立計算「通風網路與壓力損失」。原創教學假設：滲透係數=1e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.1 無因次；通水面積=400 m²。Q=k i A=0.00084 m³/s。僅把滲透係數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.000924 m³/s。邊界：均質飽和達西流，不代表裂隙集中流；不是本工程實測或允收值。原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=1300 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.5 m/s。Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=59.7188 Pa。僅把平均風速增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為72.2597 Pa。邊界：定密度直管摩阻，局部損失及外風另計；不是本工程實測或允收值。兩組結果的單位與邊界不同，不能直接相加。請列出一項缺少的現場輸入，說明它會影響哪個結論，以及哪種獨立量測可以縮小不確定度。~Original integrated review: first calculate fault connectivity and forecast updating, then independently calculate ventilation network and pressure loss. Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=1e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.1 dimensionless; flow area=400 m². Q=k i A=0.00084 m³/s. Increasing only conductivity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.000924 m³/s. Boundary: Homogeneous saturated Darcy flow, not concentrated fracture flow. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=1300 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.5 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=59.7188 Pa. Increasing only mean velocity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 72.2597 Pa. Boundary: Constant-density straight-duct friction; local loss and external wind are separate. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. The outputs have different units and boundaries and cannot simply be added. Identify one missing field input, explain which conclusion it changes and select an independent measurement to reduce uncertainty.
history: 2014 年公開記錄：新關角隧道雙線正洞於4月貫通。中國政府公開記錄新關角隧道32.645公里及2014年4月雙線正洞貫通，這個事件不是通車日期。本課從高原長距離施工出發，研究弱帶支護、地下水、通風密度修正、多工作面物流與控制網。所有空氣密度及機具數字明列為假想條件，不代替高海拔現地測量。本課把「高原施工、斷層變形與長距離物流」視為互相連動的系統，工程年代和名稱由所列公開來源核對；模型中的設備配置、荷載與量測數字另外標明為教學假設，只重建公開原理及工程推理，不是原始設計文件。~Public record for 2014: Both main bores of New Guanjiao Tunnel achieve breakthrough in April. Government records identify New Guanjiao as 32.645 km and both main bores breaking through in April 2014, distinct from opening to traffic. This course studies plateau construction through weak-zone support, water, ventilation-density correction, multi-heading logistics and survey. Air density and equipment values are hypothetical and do not replace high-altitude measurements. The course treats plateau construction, fault deformation and long-distance logistics as coupled engineering questions. Named events and dimensions follow the listed public sources; equipment scenarios, loads and measurement values are separately marked teaching assumptions. Only public principles and reasoning are reconstructed, not original design documents.
facts: 公開工程尺度約為 32.645 km，保留所列來源的計量邊界。~The public scale is about 32.645 km; retain the measurement boundary in the cited source.
2014 年事件：新關角隧道雙線正洞於4月貫通。~2014 event: Both main bores of New Guanjiao Tunnel achieve breakthrough in April.
教學「路線里程與端點」：長度=20 km，其餘輸入依單元，結果=20 min；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching alignment chainage and endpoints: length=20 km, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 20 min; not measured or accepted project data.

教學「破碎帶連通性」：滲透係數=1e-06 m/s，其餘輸入依單元，結果=0.00084 m³/s；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching fault-zone connectivity: conductivity=1e-06 m/s, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 0.00084 m³/s; not measured or accepted project data.

教學「測壓水頭」：水密度=1000 kg/m³，其餘輸入依單元，結果=1118.34 kPa；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching piezometric head: water density=1000 kg/m³, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 1118.34 kPa; not measured or accepted project data.

教學「風道摩擦壓損」：達西因子=0.025 無因次，其餘輸入依單元，結果=59.7188 Pa；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching duct friction loss: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 59.7188 Pa; not measured or accepted project data.
